title: Hang the Lantern
story: The village paths grow dark after sunset. Could someone light the lantern before night falls?

title: Paint the Front Door
story: My front door has seen better days. A fresh coat of paint would make it feel like home again.

title: Sweep the Town Square
story: Visitors arrive this afternoon. Let's make the town square sparkle!

title: Rescue the Cat
story: My little cat, Mittens, climbed the tallest tree and refuses to come down.

title: Fix the Broken Fence
story: The sheep keep escaping through the broken fence. Please mend it.

title: Water Grandma's Garden
story: My flowers are thirsty, and my old knees aren't what they used to be.

title: Unlock the Storehouse
story: I've misplaced the way into my storehouse. The supplies are waiting inside.

title: Patch the Leaky Bucket
story: My favorite bucket won't hold water anymore. Can you save it?

title: Deliver Fresh Bread
story: The bread is fresh from the oven! Help deliver it before it gets cold.

title: Ring the Bell Tower
story: It's time for the evening bell. Someone must ring it before sunset.

title: Repair the Village Cart
story: My cart is falling apart, and market day is tomorrow.

title: Fix the Windmill
story: The windmill has stopped turning. Without it, no flour can be made.

title: Clean the Old Well
story: The village well has become dirty. Everyone depends on its water.

title: Build a Chicken Coop
story: The foxes have become too bold lately. My chickens need a safer home.

title: Replace the Bridge Planks
story: Several planks have rotted away. Travelers can no longer cross safely.

title: Prepare the Harvest Festival
story: The Harvest Festival begins tonight. The whole village is counting on us!

title: Rescue the Lost Traveler
story: A traveler wandered into the woods and hasn't returned.

title: Rebuild the Market Stall
story: Yesterday's storm knocked over my market stall. I need it open by morning.

title: Catch the Runaway Pig
story: Pickles escaped again! If someone doesn't catch him soon, he'll eat everyone's vegetables.

title: Repair the Bakery Oven
story: My oven cracked this morning. Without it, there'll be no fresh bread for the village.

title: Rebuild the Watchtower
story: Our watchtower has become unsafe. It must be rebuilt before the next storm.

title: Build a New Bridge
story: The old bridge finally collapsed. The eastern farms are cut off from the village.

title: Save the Village Festival
story: The biggest celebration of the year is hours away. Everyone is counting on your help!

title: Restore the Mayor's House
story: My family home has fallen into disrepair. Together, we can make it welcoming once again.
